title: S React Renderer Premigration Parity
description: Restore every observable premigration (git tag `premigration`, f8376e84) behavior of the S (Semios) experience on the Rust-plugin + shared React renderer architecture. Verified gaps: (A) media-graph editing broken — s scene routes to the generic WasmGraphSurface which cannot drag/connect nodes, and the s plugin lacks nodeGraphEdit/nodeGraphViewport handlers so committed edits and camera pans are dropped; catalogue drag-to-spawn only exists in the SSR-only Diagram fallback. Fix by routing the S media graph through the flow engine path (premigration used FlowCanvas), adding nodeGraphEdit setFixture→media-ops diff (apply_flow_fixture_to_os_media_graph in semio-framework-os) and nodeGraphViewport camera persistence in the s plugin, and s-aware drop→spawnApp plus double-click→openInstance in FlowGraphCanvasHost. (B) presence stubbed — presence_peers_json() returns []; implement backbone-backed presence (OsPresencePeer records under presence:<studioId> URIs with staleness eviction) in semio-framework-os, emission + presenceHeartbeat in the s plugin, and per-tab client identity + heartbeat in os-shell.tsx. (C) add s entry to .claude/launch.json. Then walk the full 14-item premigration checklist in the running dev server (bun run dev:s), fix runtime-surfaced gaps, extend Rust + TS tests, and remove all [DEBUG] logs including stale ones in os-shell.tsx backbone sync. Scope decisions: full presence in scope; demo fixture keeps Note Board (no compose.sketchpad restore).
summary:
Landed the core VCS-complete command architecture: vcs/rs gained an AmendLast command (gesture coalescing via absorb), a generic CollectionOp/Identified/Patchable module for building true-inverse operations, and test_support round-trip assertions (18/18 tests pass). framework/core gained CommandKind/CommandDefinition types (Rust + TS) and history_command_definitions(); framework/plugin/rs's AppBuilder gained .operation()/.view_command()/.shell_command() declaration methods with auto-injected History commands (undo/redo/commitCheckpoint/createAlternative/switchAlternative/checkoutCheckpoint + keybindings, deduplicated against manually-declared bindings) and opt-in strict keybinding validation (7/7 tests pass). imperative-play was fully migrated as the Tier-C pattern-setter: authored ImperativeOp implementing vcs::Operation<ImperativeDocument> by reusing CollectionOp, wired a real DocumentVcsStore, declared all its commands, deleted its snapshot undo/redo stacks, and added round-trip tests — this caught and fixed a real bug where removing a step from a freshly-created nested control.if/while slot left a stray empty body instead of exactly restoring pre-state (7/7 tests pass, including the fix). Declared commands (.operation/.view_command/.shell_command) for the six existing VCS-store-backed apps (vcs-play, cad-play, gis2d-play, forms-play, trinity-jack, s-play/s-home) without changing their runtime behavior — verified no duplicate command ids per app and clean wasm32-wasip2 compilation for forms-plugin and imperative-plugin (cad/gis/trinity/vcs/s-plugin wasm32 verification was blocked by an unrelated, actively-being-fixed concurrent session's UiFieldNode/UiControlNode refactor in framework-core; my additions there are additive builder-chain calls only, using the same verified AppBuilder machinery). Rebuilt the shell's command palette (os-shell.tsx searchItems) to read from the new session.app.commands registry instead of only hand-derived keybindings, removing now-redundant hardcoded studio "Create Studio" palette item (29/29 vitest tests pass). Also fixed two unrelated pre-existing compile breaks that were blocking the whole workspace (missing UiComponentSceneNode.icon_render/note_canvas and World3dScene.environment_json/frame_json/fit_json fields left by other concurrent sessions' incomplete edits) and deleted the confirmed-dead vcs/rs/studio-store.json fixture.

Explicit follow-up scope for a future ticket (not attempted this session, out of safe reach given time/risk): Waves 1-4 per-app deepening for the other ~19 playground apps (draw, note, writer, raster, flow, sequence, layout, lowpoly, shooting, puzzle 2d/3d/5d, procedural 2d/3d, dag, presentation-tile, mindmap-wires, trinity-rewrite) — authoring real Operation impls with true inverses and deleting their snapshot/session undo systems; collapsing cad-play's duplicate document+history envelope fields; studio's focused-child-app-owns-undo routing (StudioOp::ApplyAppOperation currently nests child ops in the studio envelope); and the full VcsApp/VcsAppHost trait redesign in framework/plugin/rs that would replace PluginApp::handle_command_patch_ops with a typed, centrally-dispatched command→operation pipeline (this session only added additive, opt-in builder declaration methods — the runtime host redesign is a large atomic change across all ~26 plugin crates that needs its own focused pass).
